_comment: XW-3 case manifest for tools/scripts/qemu_xw3_vv.sh, tools/scripts/xw3_verdict.py
Every case delivers REAL octets on the QEMU serial input of the accepted XW-2
test-only image; the octets cross QEMU's serial device into the unchanged
Expectations are derived from the controlled interface (ICD section 3/4) and
the SRS, never from the captured bytes.
expect=PASS means the case's own assertion set passed. Observation cases are
recorded (counts) and never asserted, because the ICD does not fix the
behaviour; they are listed as gaps below.

asserts: the injected golden frame's CRC verifies under the oracle's own CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE implementation (SRS-REQ-004 stimulus self-check)
exactly one S17.2 whose payload equals the injected TC user data (SRS-REQ-012)
exactly one S1.1, one S1.3 and one S1.7 and no other S1 subservice (SRS-REQ-006, service/subservice only)
every accepted packet: APID 0x020, CCSDS version 0, type 0, sec-hdr 1, self-consistent PDL, valid CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE (SRS-REQ-004)
TM counters strictly increasing modulo 16384 in capture order (SRS-REQ-007)
the injected frame really has an invalid CRC (stimulus self-check)
no S17.2 response (the request was not executed)
the capture still contains CRC-valid TM, so the serial path was live and the absence is meaningful
the S17.2 and S1 acceptance counts for two identical commands are recorded
whether a frame split across two writes is reassembled by the link is recorded

gaps.reason: S1.8 reporting for a rejected/malformed frame is not asserted: SRS-REQ-005 versus the current event-only behaviour is open under NC-EXT-04. Presence/absence is recorded as an observation only.

The numeric S1 payload layout (TC type/subtype, service, subservice, error code) is authority-pending (NC-EXT-14/15). S1 packets are counted by service/subservice only; their payload prefix is recorded, not asserted.
The duplicate-command response behaviour is not fixed by the ICD; XW3-O1 records it as an observation and asserts nothing.
Frame reassembly across writes is not fixed by the ICD; XW3-O2 records it as an observation and asserts nothing.

The 6-octet TC[3,128] create form and other authority-pending service forms are not exercised; its payload width remains an interface-authority item (ESC-HK-01/NC-EXT-210) and the ICD records it as provisional (NC-EXT-17).
